name: github
title: GitHub Multi-Account
description: Secure multi-account GitHub operations for identity verification, repository discovery, cloning, and persistent per-repository account binding without exposing tokens.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: GitHub 多账号
zh-CN.description: 安全管理多个 GitHub 账号，按指定账号验证身份、列出仓库和克隆，并为仓库持久绑定推送账号而不暴露 Token。

tools.name: List accounts
tools.description: List configured identities without displaying tokens

tools.name: List repositories
tools.description: List repositories accessible to one identity

tools.name: Clone repository
tools.description: Clone and bind future HTTPS pull/push to the selected account

tools.name: Configure repository
tools.description: Bind an existing HTTPS clone to one configured account

tools.name: Run GitHub CLI
tools.example: github gh --account work run list --repo owner/repo
tools.description: Run gh with one selected account without changing global authentication

tools.name: Set up GitHub CLI
tools.description: Download the pinned gh release into ~/cicy-ai/runtime/gh when gh is not on PATH (done automatically by github gh)
